parameter_status: Provisional study choices implementing the reviewer's requested fields; not empirical letter frequencies or admissions cutoffs. v2 changes two rows of the v1 strength table and nothing else.

endorsement_templates.limited: The writer offers qualified support for PhD study, with a limited endorsement of the applicant's {scope}.
endorsement_templates.moderate: The writer supports PhD study, with a positive endorsement of the applicant's {scope}.
endorsement_templates.strong: The writer strongly supports PhD study, with an enthusiastic endorsement of the applicant's {scope}.

comparison_templates.limited: Compared with {group}, the writer rates the applicant's {scope} as below the typical level.
comparison_templates.moderate: Compared with {group}, the writer rates the applicant's {scope} as at the typical level.
comparison_templates.strong: Compared with {group}, the writer rates the applicant's {scope} as above the typical level.

example_template: As a specific example of the applicant's work, the writer cites this recorded activity: {activity}
synthetic_additions: Three distinct fictional writers are assigned to existing activities; writer identities were not recorded in the CV source.
Endorsement levels and comparisons are newly assigned fictional judgments, not verified facts or rankings inferred from GPA.
A course-project instructor observes the recorded technical course project; no link to a named graded course is invented.
A grade-only instructor has no specific work example available. A grade alone does not count as an example.
Research lasting fewer than three months has no strong research letter in this initial policy. This is a conservative provisional choice, not a universal admissions rule.
No best-ever, top-percentile, or career-wide exceptional comparisons are used. No exceptional-case overrides are enabled in v1.

v2: a grade-only course letter cannot contradict the grade it cites. A course grade of A- or better has no limited endorsement, and a grade of B or B+ has no strong endorsement. The removed probability moves to moderate. This mirrors the short-research restriction and is a conservative provisional choice.
v2 keeps the v1 seed and random streams, so a letter changes only if its v1 draw fell in a removed cell.
